title: Disclosure policy SLA evidence
description: Self-attested or live-collected record of the manufacturer's responsible disclosure channel and committed service levels. Used by GOV-DISC-065 to support EU CRA 24-hour reporting readiness. Place at .oss-policy-kit/evidence/disclosure-policy.json. Trust level: evidence-backed when collection.evidence_collection_method=live; otherwise self-attested.

attested_at.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the policy was last verified.

attested_by.description: Username, security team, or identifier of the attester.

method.description: Primary disclosure channel type. Use 'url' for a public form or advisory page.

value.description: Address, URL, or PGP key identifier corresponding to the chosen method.

pgp_fingerprint.description: Optional. Fingerprint of the public key when method=pgp or when a key is offered alongside email/url.

acknowledgement_sla_hours.description: Hours within which the manufacturer commits to acknowledge receipt of a report. Documents the *inbound* SLA — distinct from the CRA 24-hour outbound reporting clock to ENISA, but a necessary precondition for it.

triage_sla_hours.description: Hours within which the manufacturer commits to perform an initial triage / severity assessment of a report.

default_window_days.description: Default number of days between report and public disclosure. 90 is a common industry default; 0 means immediate.

negotiable.description: Whether the default window is negotiable with the reporter for legitimate cases (extension, embargo coordination).

safe_harbor.description: Optional. Whether the manufacturer commits to not pursue legal action against good-faith researchers.

out_of_scope.description: Optional. Categories explicitly excluded from the program (e.g. 'denial of service', 'social engineering', 'physical attacks').

cve_assignment_authority.description: Optional. CNA used to mint CVE IDs for confirmed reports (e.g. 'MITRE', 'GitHub', 'self').

notes.description: Optional free-text notes (e.g. coordinated-disclosure partners, regional contacts, exception reasoning).
